skills.name: Applications of Artificial Intelligence in society

note.text:
AI is used in many areas:
• Health: reading X-rays and scans, predicting disease outbreaks, chatbots giving health information.
• Agriculture: apps that identify crop diseases from a photo (e.g. cassava or cocoa leaves), weather prediction, drones monitoring fields.
• Education: tutoring apps that adapt to the learner, automatic translation.
• Business and banking: fraud detection in mobile money, customer-service chatbots, recommendations.
• Transport and security: navigation apps, traffic control, face recognition, self-driving vehicles.
• Daily life: voice assistants, spam filters, smartphone cameras.

sections.heading: AI around us
sections.text:
AI is already in many everyday tools: voice typing, phone cameras that sharpen photos, video and music recommendations, spam filters and translation apps.
It works best where there is a lot of data and a clear task.

sections.heading: AI in Cameroon's key sectors
sections.text:
• Health: programs that read X-rays and scans, help diagnose tuberculosis or malaria, and predict outbreaks.
• Agriculture: phone apps that identify diseases of cassava, maize or cocoa from a photo; weather forecasting; drones watching large farms.
• Education: tutoring apps that adapt to each learner; automatic translation between English and French.
• Business and banking: fraud detection in mobile money; chatbots answering customers.

sections.heading: Transport, security and choices
sections.text:
Navigation apps predict traffic; some cities use AI to control traffic lights; face recognition is used for security; self-driving vehicles are being tested.
AI suits tasks with clear patterns. For decisions that need human values, such as justice, people must stay in charge.

identifying what is in a picture

mistake.right: AI helps doctors, who still make the decisions
mistake.why: AI can be wrong; professionals check its results and care for patients.

worked_example.problem: A farmer near Bafoussam photographs a spotted cassava leaf with a phone app, which names the disease. Explain how AI helps here.
steps: The app was trained on thousands of labelled photos of healthy and diseased leaves.
It compares the new photo with the patterns it learned.
It gives a likely diagnosis quickly, without an expert on the farm.
worked_example.answer: Image recognition trained on labelled leaf photos
